map.TWSTRS 颈部肌张力障碍总分 = 严重程度（6 项）+ 致残（4 项）+ 疼: TWSTRS cervical dystonia total = severity (6 items) + disability (4 items) + pain score; pain score = min(20, pain severity + duration x2 + pain disability), max 75; <=20 mild, <=40 moderate, <=60 mod-severe, >60 severe.
map.TWSTRS主要用于颈部肌张力障碍(痉挛性斜颈)评估: TWSTRS is mainly used for cervical dystonia (spasmodic torticollis) assessment
map.严重程度量表需在患者坐位放松状态下观察1分钟: Severity scale needs 1-minute observation with patient seated and relaxed
